rachats.citation: Through a business acquisition in 2019, we acquired global S-band non-geostationary satellite spectrum rights for mobile satellite services (the “Helios Spectrum”).
On July 1, 2020, we completed the Boost Mobile Acquisition. / « Today, Dish announced the $1.4 billion acquisition of Boost Mobile. » (Engadget)
During the second quarter of 2021, we acquired over 200,000 subscribers as a result of the Republic Wireless Acquisition.
Merger with DISH Network On December 31, 2023, we completed the Merger with DISH Network.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
